Nankai University 2026 international undergraduate program catalog

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid passport, be in good physical and mental health, and have been born before September 1, 2008.

Meet the nationality conditions in Ministry of Education Document No. 12 (2020), including the additional review applicable to former Chinese citizens and applicants with Chinese-parent nationality circumstances.
Hold a senior-high-school diploma and demonstrate excellent academic performance.
Submit HSK Level 4 with at least 180 for general admission. The program catalog controls where it publishes HSK Level 5 or another stricter route-specific threshold.

references.locator: I. Eligibility Requirements item 3 and III. Programs

requirements.ruleText: Apply from October 20, 2025 through June 30, 2026; scholarship deadlines may be earlier.
Select up to two programs in preference order. Business Economics and Business Administration accept only first-choice applications.
Submit the passport information page; the passport must remain valid until at least September 1, 2027.
Submit a notarized highest-degree certificate and complete high-school academic transcripts, with Chinese or English translation where applicable.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants to the exact programs bound to this template
requirements.ruleText: Submit CSCA score reports for these catalog-published subjects: Chinese, Mathematics.

references.locator: 2026 undergraduate catalog - CSCA Test Subject column

requirements.ruleText: Submit a personal statement in Chinese or English.
Submit HSK Level 4 with at least 180 for general admission. The program catalog controls where it publishes HSK Level 5 or another stricter route-specific threshold.

references.locator: IV. Required Documents item 6 and program catalog

requirements.ruleText: Submit one recommendation letter.
Submit supplementary materials demonstrating comprehensive abilities when available.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Record completed after November 2025.
Submit proof of financial capability.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate.
Complete the Nankai online application and upload all required records; incomplete applications are not processed.
Participate in the university interview assessing language proficiency and comprehensive competencies.
Pay the non-refundable RMB 400 application fee and the full tuition amount within the specified period; failure to prepay tuition revokes the offer.

requirements.appliesTo: Enrolled students in the exact programs bound to this template
requirements.ruleText: Pay annual tuition of RMB 20,000.
Budget RMB 1,000-3,000 per month for accommodation and purchase comprehensive medical insurance at RMB 800 per year.
Use the admission and JW201/JW202 documents to obtain an X1 visa, convert it to a residence permit within 30 days after arrival, and present original documents for registration review.

sources.title: Nankai University 2026 international master admissions guide
Nankai University 2026 international master program catalog PDF

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid passport and meet Ministry of Education Document No. 12 (2020) where formerly a Chinese citizen.
Hold a bachelor's degree and be under age 35.

Submit HSK Level 5 with at least 180. Native Chinese speakers and applicants whose qualifying prior degree was taught in Chinese may use the stated exemption; specified literature/language schools require HSK Level 6 score 180 before graduation.
Have no criminal record and submit the supporting certificate.

references.locator: I. Qualifications item d and III.B checklist item J

requirements.ruleText: Apply online from October 20, 2025 through May 31, 2026; scholarship applicants should apply earlier according to the relevant scholarship deadline.
Complete the Nankai International Student Online Service System application and upload all required records in Chinese or English, with notarized translations when necessary.
Submit the original bachelor's diploma or expected-graduation proof and notarized undergraduate transcripts; final originals are due before registration.

references.locator: III.B Application Documents Checklist items A-B

requirements.ruleText: Submit a personal statement of at least 800 words covering the study/research plan, financial situation, scholarship reasons where applicable, awards and personal strengths.
Submit two Chinese- or English-language recommendation letters from professors or associate professors.
A Nankai supervisor acceptance letter may be submitted; the guide explicitly requires it for doctoral applicants.

Submit HSK Level 5 with at least 180. Native Chinese speakers and applicants whose qualifying prior degree was taught in Chinese may use the stated exemption; specified literature/language schools require HSK Level 6 score 180 before graduation.
Submit a copy of an ordinary passport that expires after September 2026.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form covering all listed items and completed after October 2025.
Submit a certificate of financial support.
Pass academic-school document review and a professional interview; an expert panel determines the final admission list.
Pay the RMB 600 application fee at registration; Chinese Government Scholarship winners are exempt under the guide.

requirements.appliesTo: Enrolled students in the exact programs bound to this template
requirements.ruleText: Pay annual tuition of RMB 30,000.
Budget RMB 1,000-3,000 per month for accommodation and purchase medical insurance at RMB 800 per year.
Obtain an X1 visa using the admission and JW201/JW202 records, register on the dates in the admission notice, and present the original qualifying degree for admission review.
